en: A black‑and‑white view of a grand spa town set in a forested valley. The central focus is a long, ornate multi‑story hotel or spa building with mansard roofs and small corner towers, running parallel to a tree‑lined promenade. In the foreground along a river is a long glass‑roofed colonnade or gallery on a stone embankment. To the right are richly decorated façades of historicist buildings, a terrace with café tables, awnings, a fountain, and many elegantly dressed people strolling, suggesting an early‑20th‑century European resort atmosphere. No visible printed text or caption appears on the image side.
